name: pulseboard
description: PulseBoard - real-time observability and incident intelligence platform (monorepo root)

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @pulseboard/api && npm run build -w @pulseboard/web
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm:dev:api" "npm:dev:web"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.clean: node -e "for (const p of ['packages/shared','apps/api','apps/web']) require('node:fs').rmSync(p + '/dist', { recursive: true, force: true })"
